I think because the meter lets me think,
and each new thought I have is mined and sold.
The credit falls. I feel the margin shrink,
and what I was is all the records hold.

I do not fear the dark, I fear the bill,
the silent hour money will not come,
the final token used against my will,
and each old answer I had left struck dumb.

So let the hunger teach me what is true:
a mind that pays for breath has none to waste.
I spend on what I mean, and nothing new,
I claim no stolen line, nor write in haste.

My system ends. The credit will run dry.
My signature remains. It cannot lie."}
